Ghosh et al. (2012) · Standard 3 or 4 nm CdSe core route

New Insights into the Complexities of Shell Growth and the Strong Influence of Particle Volume in Nonblinking “Giant” Core/Shell Nanocrystal Quantum Dots

Yagnaseni Ghosh; Benjamin D. Mangum; Joanna L. Casson; Darrick J. Williams; Han Htoon; Jennifer A. Hollingsworth · 2012 · 10.1021/ja212032q ↗

Evidence typeliterature protocol

Complete supplied ten-page main article and matched nine-page SI read and independently audited. Separate canonical/reader, molecular and apparatus audits passed. Two routes, three variants, ten supporting procedures and six observation contexts remain distinct. Missing precursor preparations, unresolved specimen joins and source-scoped comparisons are retained. No new training task or exact structure–recipe pair is admitted.

Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
precursor preparation

Charge TOPO, ODE and Cd-oleate

Charge TOPO, ODE and Cd-oleate. Charge TOPO, ODE and Cd-oleate into a round-bottom flask with reflux condenser and thermocouple, under standard air-free conditions. The source cites reference 4 for a modified parent method; that reference has not been read. Missing fields: Cd-oleate preparation.

04
synthesis

Grow for several minutes then cool to room temperature

Grow for several minutes then cool to room temperature. After several minutes, cool to room temperature and collect by ethanol precipitation and centrifugation. Exact time distinguishing 3 from 4 nm is not supplied. Missing fields: exact duration for each size.

05
workup

Precipitate with ethanol, centrifuge and repeat; disperse retained particles in hexane

Precipitate with ethanol, centrifuge and repeat; disperse retained particles in hexane. Redisperse collected cores in hexane after two to three precipitation/collection cycles. Ethanol and hexane quantities and centrifugation conditions are absent. Missing fields: centrifuge settings, solvent amounts, yield.
